## Ask Grant. His team does the legwork.

Ask in plain words. Grant brings in the right specialists, shows their sources, and keeps long jobs going until they report back.

Consult

Grant asks up to six teammates at once and answers with citations. Paid plans do this live.

Background work

Work still running after about 45 seconds, or when you ask, keeps going in the background and reports back in the same conversation.

Check-ins

The team checks in on your plan’s schedule (daily on Pro, every six hours on Studio) and when GitHub reports a workflow run, a check, a push or a new alert.

Decisions

Assign an owner, defer to a date or mark it addressed. The next check-in picks up where you left off. Marking it addressed records your decision; it isn’t proof. A disconnected account holds up only its own sources.

### Repairs that fit your workflow.

Since.dev traces supported upstream changes to affected code and prepares a focused patch.

- #### Your checks, already in place.

Draft PRs use your existing CI.
- #### Revisions on the same PR.

Request a revision in the dashboard, or mention the installed GitHub app in a comment on its repair PR. Since updates the same PR and reruns its checks.
- #### The source behind the fix.

Upstream evidence stays with the repair.
- #### One repair a month on Free.

Free repositories stay in Monitor only. The allowance is used only when a draft PR opens; failed or rejected attempts do not use it.

## Ask where you already work. Same Grant. Same team. Same findings.

Ask in a Slack thread, the dashboard or your agent’s MCP client. Each one reaches the same Grant, his team and your findings.

Like a teammate in the thread. DMs are private and persistent. Nothing Grant says is ephemeral. Channel answers stay within the projects the connection covers.

Watch the team work. Stop any one of them.

Your agent can ask too. 20 tools; start with `grant_team_status`. Waits up to 55 seconds, then call again with the same `requestKey`.

Connect in a minute: MCP, an HTTP API and signed webhooks. Catch up on changes since your agent’s last acknowledged update. New watches cover future changes only.
